slides.title: Pick the date, theme and guest list
slides.body: The 31st or the weekend before? Kids, adults or both? Decide these first and everything else follows.

slides.title: Send the invites
slides.body:
Guests plan costumes and babysitters early.
An animated invite goes out by text in minutes.

slides.title: Announce the costume theme
slides.body: Give everyone time to find a costume. Put the theme right on the invite so nobody misses it.

slides.title: RSVP reminder, food and playlist
slides.body: Send a friendly nudge to anyone who hasn't replied. Then plan snacks, drinks and music for the head count you have.

slides.title: Carve, bake, decorate
slides.body:
Pumpkins, snacks that can sit out,
and a corner for photos.

slides.title: Lights low, music up
slides.body: LED candles if kids are around, playlist on, door open. Now enjoy your own party.

slides.title: Step one is ready
slides.body: Halloween invites, already designed. Edit in free Canva and send them tonight.
